title: Tall whites' gated compound on Orcas, reached by an unmarked black helicopter

tellings.quote: And he goes they have a compound on the Orcus Island.

plain: The story goes that the "tall whites", tall pale beings who come up in UFO lore, have a gated compound on Orcas Island, and that people get there by an unmarked black helicopter. Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says a friend of his on Orcas Island told him this: "they have a compound on the Orcus Island." If true, beings that are not human would be living in a guarded place in plain sight.
